observation.command: for a in app cms boards; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 90 -H "Host: ${a}.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/ 2>&1); echo "${a} -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}"; done
